goal: Book a 15 minute call to set up a referral arrangement.

openers.partner_program_page: Saw {{business_name}} already partners with a few vendors for your customers.
openers.hiring_post: Saw {{business_name}} is growing the team in {{city}}.
openers.review_spike: Your customers clearly like working with {{business_name}}. The reviews say it.
openers.new_business_filing: Saw {{business_name}} recently set up shop in {{city}}.
openers.listing_only: You work with a lot of {{customer_noun}} around {{city}}.

steps.subject: your customers' card fees

steps.body: Call script: ask how many merchant customers they serve monthly and whether anyone asks them about payments. Offer a one page referral card they can hand out.

steps.subject: the one pager
steps.body:
{{first_name}}, one more thought. Partners usually start by sending me the one customer who complains about fees the most. If the review saves them money, you look good and you get paid. Want me to send over the one pager?

{{sender_name}}
